claim: Raumland's 'triple brut' program showed the way.
because: Raumland's own site and trade listings show no 'triple brut' programme. Raumland's flagship is the Triumvirat Grande Cuvée, and the house calls itself the first VDP.Sektgut. The VDP.SEKT.STATUT was adopted in 2020 and introduced in 2021, and Raumland released the first VDP.Sekt.Prestige collection.
fix: Raumland, the first VDP.Sektgut, released the first VDP.Sekt.Prestige collection; its long-lees Triumvirat showed the way.
